notes: No H853 is present to carry the appositional 'even', so it belongs to the resumptive name itself rather than being 'added'; rule 16's 'even' clause is about the object marker and does not reach this case.
'right hand' heads on 'right' by rule 31's subtraction: 'his hand' alone loses the יָמִין lexeme.
The article on the participle is rendered by a bare relative 'who' with no supplied pronoun, so that is all it takes (rule 41).
